title: Increasing or decreasing
text: Look for an interval where the function is either strictly increasing or strictly decreasing. If it does both, it fails the Horizontal Line Test.

title: Test midpoints and end points
text: Test the midpoints and endpoints. For example, in $$[0, \pi], $$ $$\sin(\pi/4)\approx$$ $$0.707$$ and $$\sin(3\pi/4)\approx$$ $$0.707$$. Since two different inputs give the same output, it is not $$1-1$$.

title: Graph the function
text: Visualize the sine wave. Between $$x=\pi/2$$ (a peak) and $$x=3\pi/2$$ (a valley), the function is strictly decreasing. This makes it a valid candidate for an inverse.\n##figure1.gif##
